problem: SQLite startup executes PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL before installing a bounded busy_timeout, so an externally held lock can surface SQLITE_BUSY during repository initialization.
violatedInvariant: A bounded SQLite busy wait must be installed before any startup pragma that can require a write lock.
rootCause: The initialization statement order placed journal_mode=WAL before busy_timeout.
whyPriorControlsMissed: The previous test suite did not exercise startup while another connection held the SQLite lock.
There was no reusable static recurrence guard for the known bad initialization shape.
A source-only check would not by itself prove the runtime impact; the missing behavioral scenario was the authoritative gap.
knownVariants: M1: reintroduce journal_mode=WAL before busy_timeout in the fixed source while retaining surrounding comments and otherwise-fixed code.
legalControls: The same pragma strings may appear in the same order when they are not executed through the database Exec loop; that is not this defect class.
